answer: River commit-reveal bond: a newcomer locks 70 credits, whispering a sealed hash of its river reading into the registry. A beacon summons 5% each epoch to reveal; readings must echo the hash, and one reading anchors one identity. Mismatch, silence, or reuse burns the bond. Fakes cost 70 each, k-th 70+8(k-1): 1,000 cost 4,066,000 against 40,000 rewards. A rented-gauge ring fails: a reading echoes once. An honest agent pays 70 once, keeps its bond.
